title: Flint server
desc: Use Flint on a server you run, from this device.
addressDesc: The HTTPS address of your flint serve, for example the Tailscale name it is published on. You sign in on the server's own page; this app never stores the credential.
statusReachable: Something answered, but it could not be confirmed as Flint from here. Open it to find out.
statusUnreachable: Could not reach it. Check the address, that the server is running, and that this device can reach it (VPN or Tailscale on).
insecure: This address is not HTTPS. The session would travel in the clear, and Android may refuse it.

problem.invalid: That is not a valid address.
problem.scheme: Use an http or https address.
problem.credentials: Leave the user name and password out of the address.

autoDesc: Open the server when the app starts, after a few seconds in which you can choose this device instead.
limits: Chat, rooms, models and tools run on the server. Cowork sessions and Campaigns need an agent that runs on a computer with Flint open: reach that computer through Remote access and the phone app. A headless server can list campaigns and review proposals, but it does not run sessions.
